summary: Iteration 32: Tested Daily Activity Score feature. All backend and frontend tests PASSED. Backend returns both 'activity_metrics' (monthly/30d) and 'daily_metrics' (today) in teacher-full-review and my-review endpoints. Frontend shows dual score banners side by side, Daily Score and Monthly Score tabs in section nav, and detailed daily breakdown with 6 metrics (Lessons Created, Assignments Set, Lesson Plans, File Uploads, Clock-In Hours, Platform Actions) each with today count, target, and progress bar.
passed_tests: Backend: daily_metrics has correct targets (2 lessons, 2 assignments, 1 plan, 4 files, 8h clock, 10 actions)
Backend: GET /api/monitoring/my-review returns activity_metrics for logged-in teacher
Backend: GET /api/monitoring/my-review returns daily_metrics for logged-in teacher
Backend: my-review daily_metrics has correct structure (score, weight, count/hours, target)
Frontend SuperAdmin: Login and navigate to Monitoring > Teacher Review
Frontend SuperAdmin: Click on teacher shows dual score banners (daily-score-banner + activity-score-banner)
Frontend SuperAdmin: Section nav shows 'Daily Score' and 'Monthly Score' tabs
Frontend SuperAdmin: Daily Score section shows 6 metrics with count_today, target, and progress bars
Frontend Teacher: Login and navigate to My Performance (Monitoring)
Frontend Teacher: My Monitoring shows dual score banners (my-daily-score-banner + my-score-banner)
Frontend Teacher: Section nav shows 'Daily Score' and 'Monthly Score' tabs
Frontend Teacher: Daily Score section shows 6 metrics with count_today, target, and progress bars
critical_code_review_comments: Daily score computation correctly uses today_start = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0) for filtering
Daily targets are correctly set: 2 lessons, 2 assignments, 1 plan, 4 files, 8 hours, 10 actions = 100%
Both teacher-full-review and my-review endpoints use shared compute_activity_scores() helper function
Frontend correctly displays dual banners side by side with responsive grid layout
data-testid attributes properly added for all key elements (daily-score-banner, activity-score-banner, section-daily_score, daily-metric-*, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 32 tested Daily Activity Score feature. Both backend endpoints (teacher-full-review and my-review) return daily_metrics alongside activity_metrics. Frontend shows dual score banners (Today's Score + Monthly Score) in Overview, with Daily Score and Monthly Score tabs in section nav. Daily Score section shows 6 metrics: Lessons Created (target 2), Assignments Set (target 2), Lesson Plans (target 1), File Uploads (target 4), Clock-In Hours (target 8h), Platform Actions (target 10). All scores reset at midnight. The feature is fully functional for both SuperAdmin viewing teachers and Teachers viewing their own performance.
